Here is my restaurant dashboard

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets)
library(plotly)
data("rest_inspec")

```
Column {data-width=350}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Chart A
```{r}
rest_inspec |>
  filter(boro %in% c(
    "Manhattan", "Brooklyn", "Queens",
    "Bronx", "Staten Island"
  )) |>
  count(boro) |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~boro,
    y = ~ n,
    type = "bar"
)
```
